findings.evidence: Identical `refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ · simpa using (hcont.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] ...` blocks in both `hpath` proofs; the same `hc_pos.tendsto 0`/`hc_neg.tendsto 0` pattern in `not_continuousAt_of_eqOn_polylog_of_one_lt`.
findings.fix: Factor one private lemma, e.g. `tendsto_ofReal_add_mul_I_nhdsWithin_im_pos (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (x : ℂ) + t * I) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[{z | 0 < z.im}] x)` and its `im_neg` counterpart for `x - t * I`, and reuse them at all four sites.
findings.issue: The same path-limit argument (continuity of `t ↦ x ± t * I`, `tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff`, and an `im` check via `self_mem_nhdsWithin`) is written out four times: `hpath` in `tendsto_polylog_sub_mul_I_nhdsGT_zero`, `hpath` in `tendsto_polylog_add_mul_I_nhdsGT_zero_of_one_lt`, and `hpath_pos`/`hpath_neg` with the `hc_pos`/`hc_neg` setup in `not_continuousAt_of_eqOn_polylog_of_one_lt`.

summary: The new boundary, conjugation and uniform-integrability material is genuinely new and reuses Mathlib and TauCeti API well, but it adds two unused numeric special cases of its own general lemmas and repeats one path-limit argument four times.
